VisionQuest#1 'No Strings' (aired 2026-10-13): Vision lives with J.A.R.V.I.S. and other AIs in his Mindspace, who help him with social interaction. J.A.R.V.I.S. runs security and housekeeping there and acts as an older brother. This is a new tie, separate from the stage #2 death.
